title: Admission thresholds helped; semantic admission did not beat matched caches
summary: The policy-agnostic store threshold sharply reduced writes. Adding semantic/cost-aware admission did not establish an incremental serving benefit over matched ARC or LRU.
scope: 420 valid cells, 10,500 requests, five seeds and four workload profiles on RTX 5080. Matched output-token digests and block identities agreed.
limitations: No loads, restores or prefetches occurred. Threshold effects cannot be interpreted as a retention or prefetch win; results belong to the earlier implementation.
decision: Preserve threshold admission as a separate hypothesis. Do not revive semantic admission solely from its improvement over an unguarded baseline.

chart.caption: Reported paired seed-level 95% intervals. Different comparisons answer different questions; higher is faster.
